name: Splativerse
summary:
Explore your scans from the inside.

Splativerse turns compatible Gaussian splat files into immersive spaces you can move through on Meta Quest. Look around, fly through a scene, and save the viewpoints you want to return to.

• Import SPZ, PLY and SPLAT files from your headset.
• Search and sort your scan library.
• Save, name and revisit Views, including directly inside a scene.
• Hide scans from navigation without deleting their files or saved Views.
• Adjust the viewing radius and appearance.
